newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia's Eterindo Wahanatama to list in April.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia's Eterindo Wahanatama to list in April.

text.p: Indonesian chemical company PT Eterindo Wahanatama said on Tuesday it expected to raise $100 million through an initial public offering (IPO) of 170 million shares next month.
The company said the offer period was April 23-25, and would be listed on the Jakarta and Surabaya stock exchanges.
"The proceeds will be used for the group's expansion...to play a more significant role in supplying domestic and Asian markets," Eterindo president-director Hadiran Sridjaja said in a statement.
Eterindo produces chemical products including phthalic abhydride, maleic anhydride, plasticizers, alkyd and amino resins, synthetic latex resins and unsaturated polyester resins.
Vickers Ballas Tamara has been appointed the managing underwriter while the Union Bank of Switzerland will be the international coordinator for the IPO.
